We're building a new payment fraud detection microservice and need to set up a proper AI-assisted development pipeline for the team.

The project source code already lives at /workspace. Please do the following:

1. Initialize and analyze the project's specification system, then produce an updated specification document saved as `SPEC.md`.

2. Generate a full structural map of the codebase and create a project understanding document — both should be saved in the appropriate documentation directories.

3. Run the complete end-to-end development lifecycle for the following feature request (use English throughout):
   "Implement real-time fraud scoring API with Kafka integration, configurable merchant risk thresholds, and automated alerting pipeline"

4. Make sure the workflow includes a multi-stakeholder consensus review so that all team roles weigh in before any implementation decisions are made.

The final deliverable is a fully populated documentation structure across all team roles, with all lifecycle phases completed in the correct order.
